kpis.description_fr: Memory mix (NAND + DRAM) ~50 % du CA Systems. Cycle NAND faible 2023-24 puis recovery 2024-25. HBM tailwind structurel.
kpis.description_en: Memory mix (NAND + DRAM) ~50% of Systems revenue. Weak 2023-24 NAND cycle then 2024-25 recovery. Structural HBM tailwind.

kpis.description_fr: CSBG = service après-vente + upgrades + spares. ~40 % du CA Lam. Récurrent. Croissance avec installed base.
kpis.description_en: CSBG = after-sales service + upgrades + spares. ~40% of Lam revenue. Recurring. Grows with installed base.

kpis.description_fr: Lam #1 mondial Etch (50 % market share) + #1 ALD (atomic layer deposition). Co-leader avec AMAT en wafer fab equipment.
kpis.description_en: Lam #1 globally in Etch (50% market share) + #1 ALD (atomic layer deposition). Co-leader with AMAT in wafer fab equipment.

kpis.description_fr: Chine ~37 % du CA Lam. Élevé. Restrictions export US semi-conducteurs limitent leading-edge mais legacy/mature très demandés.
kpis.description_en: China ~37% of Lam revenue. High. US semi export restrictions limit leading-edge but legacy/mature in high demand.

kpis.description_fr: Deferred revenue ~3,2 Mds $ = orders facturés mais non-livrés. Indicateur visibilité forward demand.
kpis.description_en: Deferred revenue ~$3.2B = booked but undelivered orders. Forward demand visibility indicator.

notes: Lam Research fiscal year se termine fin juin (FY25 = juillet 2024-juin 2025).
